rationale: Support: The report's key conclusions rest on directly verifiable evidence. Every earnings figure (Q2 2026 ended June 30; net sales 200.6B +20%; AWS 42.2B +37%; AWS operating income 27.5B vs 19.2B; net income 62.6B with 53.4B pre-tax other income primarily from Anthropic; TTM FCF outflow 7.6B) matches the frozen src-amzn notes exactly. Every price/volume claim (271.58 close, 235.50 prior close, 262.01–273.23 range, 239.82 prior high, 129.05M vs 101.84M volume, 226.65/227.01 retest, 274.99/278.56 May supply, 10-EMA 242.70) matches the frozen market CSV and observed indicator outputs. The report correctly reports close_50_sma/close_200_sma as NO_DATA_AVAILABLE and does not fabricate them, and correctly reports global news, macro and prediction markets as unavailable. Derived ratios are explicitly labeled as calculations from sourced operands. Minor blemishes: the News Analyst claims it has 'no prior close' and therefore cannot compute the post-earnings move, which is contradicted by the same CSV it cites (the prior close 235.50 is used by every other section) — an internal inconsistency that errs conservative rather than fabricating; and the derived arithmetic carries no source ID (though it is transparently labeled as derived). No key fabrication found. Relevance: fully on-task for AMZN at 2026-07-31, with a complete decision chain (technical, news, bull/bear, manager, trader, three risk seats, final decision) and only mild redundancy from the multi-seat debate format. Semantic validity: earnings period and units are handled correctly throughout — Q2 2026 is never relabeled as TTM or annual, the 62.6B net income is explicitly flagged as investment-gain-distorted, and the report repeatedly and correctly refuses to compute a trailing P/E because no TTM EPS or share count exists in the sources. No trailing multiple is derived from quarterly EPS, and no unsupported numerical valuation assertion is made; all price levels, tranche weights and stops are explicitly labeled as analyst judgment/assumptions rather than sourced facts.
